name: talesworn-laoBui2
message: A 62x38, 5-frame one-shot dust kick: round puffy white-grey clouds grow at the right end around (48, 30) in frames 1-2, drift up and thin in 3-4, and vanish in 5, with three horizontal speed lines trailing left to the edge. The palette is white and light grey only with a grey outline, so the game tint will carry it. The puffs stay small and somewhat separate, so at 1x they read as a dust puff more than a dense cloud; the speed-line timing and puff size are the sliders to adjust.
